case-01.problem: The checkout event is tracked with the submitted email as identifier while exposure uses the vid cookie, so conversions never join to exposures.

case-02.problem: A fresh random visitor ID is generated on every page load and never persisted, so a returning user gets a new identity and is re-bucketed and counted as a new exposure.

case-04.problem: A custom self-hosted api_url is set but no events URL is configured, so exposure and conversion events are not sent to the instance that receives them.

case-05.problem: enable_events=True is missing from the Flagsmith client, so no exposures or conversion events are recorded.

case-06.problem: enableEvents: true is missing from flagsmith.init, so no exposures or conversion events are recorded.

case-07.problem: The batch job exits without flushing and has no EventProcessorConfig(max_buffer_items=1), so buffered exposure and conversion events are lost.

case-08.problem: getExperimentFlag is called before identify(), so the exposure is recorded for the wrong (anonymous) identity while the conversion uses the identified visitor.

case-10.problem: The /pricing handler always generates a new uuid instead of reusing the vid cookie, so every page view is a new user and the later checkout identity never matches the exposure.

case-13.problem: A custom self-hosted api_url is set but no events API URL is configured via EventProcessorConfig, so events are not delivered to the instance that receives them.

case-14.problem: enable_events=True is missing from the Flagsmith client, so no exposures or conversion events are recorded.
A custom self-hosted api_url is set without an events URL, so events would not reach the right endpoint even once enabled.

case-16.problem: enable_events=True is missing from the Flagsmith client, so no events are recorded.
The /pricing handler always generates a new uuid instead of reusing the vid cookie, so the identity differs on every view and from the one used at checkout.

case-17.problem: The /pricing handler always generates a new uuid instead of reusing the vid cookie, so every view is a new identity.
The checkout event uses the submitted email as identifier, which never matches the exposure identity.

case-18.problem: A custom self-hosted api URL is set but no eventProcessorConfig eventsApiUrl, so events are not delivered to the instance that receives them.

case-19.problem: enableEvents: true is missing from flagsmith.init, so no exposures or conversion events are recorded.
A custom self-hosted api URL is set without an events URL, so events would not reach the right endpoint even once enabled.

case-21.problem: getExperimentFlag is called before identify(), so the exposure is recorded for the wrong (anonymous) identity while the conversion uses the identified visitor.
